description: D-340 pressure fixture — the second generation. Offers echo.ping@2 (a NEW op version; echo itself keeps answering @1 — no route conflict, no reboot). twin.probe@1 calls echo.ping@1 through the old token: the version-locked caller must keep hitting the v1 generation even while v2 is live — per-execution generation pinning (requirement #9), demonstrated from inside a compartment rather than asserted at unit level.

capabilities.justification: The upgraded generation keeps a 1.x-pinned token so the in-flight/old-range caller story is exercised from a compartment, not only from tests.
